headline: Florida Tech clinch first place
dek: Florida Tech finished their ten conference matches four points clear of Embry-Riddle, and Rollins' win over Saint Leo on Thursday leaves every side on ten. Florida Tech still have one match to come, against Rollins, and Embry-Riddle theirs against Tampa.
displaced_by: The standing dek called Florida Tech's win over Florida Southern the last match either side had scheduled, but both play again on 2026-11-02. Rollins v Saint Leo has also now been played. The headline still holds and stands.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Florida Southern have outscored every other programme, but goals have not settled the table: Florida Tech lead it on a total from the middle of the pack.

wire.line: Saint Leo, Eckerd and Nova Southeastern have no match left; every other side in the conference still has one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic's home matches against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's home match against Trinity in September, have all passed their date with no result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored seventeen of Palm Beach Atlantic's 28 goals this season, from 61 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finlay Prain has scored sixteen of Rollins' 30 goals this season, from 71 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marcos da Silva has kept five clean sheets for Embry-Riddle.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern have conceded 34 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

last_match.line: Rollins now sit level on points with Palm Beach Atlantic and Tampa; Saint Leo end their schedule on a defeat.

next_match.line: These sides drew when they met at Rollins; Rollins arrive on the back of a win.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
